text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor c-o-n-s-p-i-r-e-d to r-i-g the p-u-b-l-i-c t-e-n-d-e-r with c-o-v-e-r b-i-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a f-r-a-u-d-u-l-e-n-t b-i-d-d-i-n-g f-i-l-e behind while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-a-i-r c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w.
2) the actor a-g-r-e-e-d on h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n among the f-i-r-m-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-r-o-s-s s-i-d-e s-e-t-t-l-e-m-e-n-t a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e c-h-e-c-k.
3) the actor e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n with the c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-h-a-r-e-d p-r-i-c-e f-i-x-i-n-g c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-l-l-u-s-i-o-n s-c-r-e-e-n-i-n-g s-t-e-p.
4) the actor d-e-f-i-n-e-d a w-i-n-n-e-r r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e for the c-o-n-t-r-a-c-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a p-r-e-p-l-a-n-n-e-d a-w-a-r-d p-a-t-t-e-r-n d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-m-p-a-r-t-i-a-l i-t-y a-u-d-i-t.
5) the actor d-e-s-i-g-n-e-d the p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t to l-o-o-k c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e to the m-u-n-i-c-i-p-a-l-i-t-y, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a f-a-l-s-e-l-y c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e t-e-n-d-e-r f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-h-o-r-o-u-g-h f-r-a-u-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w.
